LESSON: READING THREE TO FOUR LETTER WORDS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.8: Reading three to four letter words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading three to four letter words. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we blend syllables (3 HRS) form three to four letter to make words?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out •
2. Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out •
   In simple words: practise until you can read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out •. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class
   In simple words: practise until you can enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading three to four letter words using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading three to four letter words in the examples.
2. Explain Reading three to four letter words to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading three to four letter words.
4. Show that you can: Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out •

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading three to four letter words using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading three to four letter words important for a PP2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Practise learner’s ability to read in and out of class. reading three and four words? letter words in pairs and b) Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Read three to four letter small groups. words correctly in and out •
2. Enjoy participating in four letter words. activities that involve reading three to four letter words in and out of class
